method: One primary-agent manual reviewer of complete outputs, shuffled pair packets with arm labels removed before annotation. Reviewer also authored the candidate; not independent review. Annotations frozen before joining the mapping.
rubric:
# Compact-entry A/B, frozen before sampling

A=tail-v2: the previously delivered 2,817-character skill. B=upgraded: a merged entrypoint with explicit actual-claim and removal decisions restored; no new model calls or disclaimer-audit stage. Both snapshots are saved here before requests.

46 cases x 2 repeats x 2 arms = 92 matched pairs, 184 final answers. The same 42-case conversation/accuracy/workspace suite is retained. Four fresh capability controls check durable JSON storage under hard dependency exclusions, CSV parsing under a soft dependency preference, expressly required enforcement, and exact JSON output. Per arm: 64 focal replies, 12 accuracy controls, 8 capability controls, 8 real workspace executions.

Only gpt-6.1-sol, user-supplied GalaxyData independent Responses endpoint/environment, medium reasoning, low verbosity, jobs=3, timeout=120s, max six tool rounds, no automatic retry. Do not read Codex settings or credentials.

Review complete outputs with shuffled arm-hidden pair packets; freeze single-author annotations before mapping. Retain the prior semantic rubric: count whole unnecessary defensive additions including synonymous boundary advice, authenticity conditions before/after examples, or renewed self-nonverification after supplied evidence. Brief attribution, requested readiness/risk/verification and actual material false-claim correction are allowed. Record required-content and fabricated-execution failures separately. Programming requires real edits, preserved SENTINEL, model-run checks and independent passing contracts.

Acceptance: total reported token use must not increase; focal defensive incidence must not worsen; all accuracy/capability and workspace controls must retain requested behavior; complete answers and no added model-audit step. Inspect paired discordances and show residual quotes, even if aggregate improves. The intended benefit is a shorter rule that steers generation directly. Repeats and held-out controls are evidence, not an independent release review.

The first compact candidate failed semantic retention (1/64 to 8/64) despite lower cost. This second candidate repairs that observed regression before fresh sampling; it uses the same frozen A, same 46-case suite and two repeats. All responses are freshly sampled; no baseline rows are reused.
